items.title: Russian forces reduce assault attempts in Kharkiv region – SBGS
items.teaser: Russian forces have reduced their assault activity in the Kharkiv sector over the past week due to preventive actions by Ukraine's Defense Forces and deteriorating weather conditions.

items.title: Brücken-Krieg: Gefahr für Kiew, Probleme für Russlands Logistik
items.teaser: Kiew, Saporischschja, Odessa - immer wieder greift Russland ukrainische Brücken an. Im Gegenzug schießt die Ukraine vermehrt zurück - auch auf die Krim-Brücke. Dabei geht es beiden Seiten nicht immer nur um militärische Ziele. Von R. Barth.

items.title: Moldova and Romania plan to develop Prut River navigation with links to Ukraine
items.teaser: Moldova has proposed working with Romania to develop river infrastructure and restore navigation on the Prut River, partly to strengthen transport links with Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike 2 Russian oil refineries in massive attack
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces struck two Russian oil refineries, setting the sites ablaze in a massive attack overnight on Nov. 25, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Officer suspected of torturing subordinates extradited from Mondova to Ukraine
items.teaser: A Ukrainian serviceman suspected of ill-treating his subordinates has been extradited from Moldova to Ukraine.

items.title: German city of Darmstadt donates generators to schools and kindergartens in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: A delegation from the German city of Darmstadt, led by Mayor Hanno Benz, has donated five high-capacity generators worth more than €116,000 to Uzhhorod to ensure uninterrupted operations at schools and kindergartens.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 2 in Odesa Oblast, including child, injure more in Kyiv
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Odesa Oblast killed two people, including a teenager, and injured one other person, while another strike on a Kyiv residential building courtyard injured two people in Ukraine's capital late on Nov. 24.

items.title: SSU arrests suspected Russian agent posing as volunteer to direct strikes on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has arrested a contract soldier who, according to investigators, had gone AWOL from his military unit and was helping Russian forces direct strikes on Kramatorsk in the Donetsk region.

items.title: Most Germans now oppose arming Ukraine. Far-right voters resist hardest: 88% against
items.teaser: Support has dropped 13 points in a year, even as Germany gave Kyiv €11.5 billion in 2026, a third of all partner aid.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1735: Ukrainian sources say Pentagon chief has not signed off on 60 Patriot missiles that allies paid for
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says Ukraine needs more F-16s and Gripens against Russia's jet-powered Shaheds, Ukraine is preparing its big cities for water and sewage outages after Russian strikes, and the EU has proposed a 22nd sanctions package.

items.title: Norwegian firm behind NASAMS air defense builds new system around cheap Ukrainian missiles. Called Desna, it already fires at Russian drones, Oslo says
items.teaser: Air defense missiles run short worldwide. Ukraine and Norway answer with Desna.

items.title: Debris from Russian drone causes fire in 16-story residential building in Kyiv
items.teaser: A fire broke out in a 16-story residential building in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after debris from a Russian drone fell on it.

items.title: Zelensky presents Magyar with 1942 newspapers mentioning his great-grandfather, who worked in Mukachevo
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has presented Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar with historical newspapers from 1942 that mention his great-grandfather, who worked as a notary in Mukachevo. Magyar also recalled his first visit to the Zakarpattia region, where he brought humanitarian aid as a school student.

items.title: Hungary sees Ukraine's EU accession as lengthy process – Magyar
items.teaser: Hungary will continue providing humanitarian assistance to Ukraine but does not agree to linking its funding to the European Union's seven-year budget and views EU accession as a lengthy process.

items.title: Around 100 civilians trapped on occupied Kinburn Spit face winter without food or medicine. Ukraine seeks a humanitarian evacuation similar to Oleshky
items.teaser: Russian forces are preventing residents from leaving the isolated peninsula, while shortages of food and essential medicines put the mostly elderly population at risk.

items.title: Russian drones strike Merefa, Lozova in Kharkiv region, six injured
items.teaser: Russian drones struck the cities of Merefa and Lozova in the Kharkiv region on the evening of November 24, injuring six people.

items.title: "Russisches Starlink" - Wie kann Rasswet den Ukraine-Krieg verändern?
items.teaser: Das US-Starlink-System von SpaceX spielt in der Ukraine eine wichtige Rolle bei der Abwehr der militärischen Aggression Russlands. Der Kreml hat nun beschlossen, ein Pendant dazu aufzubauen. Welche Gefahr birgt das?

items.title: Russian strikes on Odesa region kill two, including 17-year-old boy, injure three
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the Odesa region on the evening of November 24, killing a man and a 17-year-old boy and injuring three people.

items.title: People in occupied Donetsk and Luhansk are asking Putin to turn the lights back on. Two petitions have drawn over 55,000 signatures
items.teaser: Occupied Crimea will get 30% less power for up to ten days from 25 November, its Moscow-installed head said.

items.title: Ukraine seeks equal partnership with Hungary, support for its EU integration – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine seeks equal partnership with Hungary, support for its European integration path, and closer bilateral cooperation in energy, trade, infrastructure and security.

items.title: Rescuer killed in Russian shelling of Kramatorsk
items.teaser: A rescuer has been killed in a Russian attack on Kramatorsk.

items.title: Presidential Medal of Freedom: Donald Trump gewährt Rudy Giuliani höchste Ehren
items.teaser: Berühmt wurde er als Bürgermeister, als Terroristen das World Trade Center in New York angriffen. Doch in den vergangenen Jahren machte Rudy Giuliani vor allem mit Skandalen von sich reden - und als Anwalt von Donald Trump. Der zeichnet ihn nun aus.

items.title: Ukraine allocates nearly UAH 2B for distributed generation this year – Shmyhal
items.teaser: About UAH 2 billion was allocated from the state budget this year to develop distributed generation in Ukrainian communities.

items.title: Two killed and three injured, including child, in Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast – photo
items.teaser: Two people, aged 41 and 17, have been killed and three others, including a 12-year-old child, have been injured in Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian enterprise in Balakliia community
items.teaser: Russian invaders have struck a civilian enterprise in the Borshchivka district of the Balakliia community in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Verteidigungsminister: Ukraine und Norwegen skalieren Produktion eines neuen Luftverteidigungssystems
items.teaser: Die Ukraine und Norwegen haben die Produktion eines neuen Luftabwehrsystems gestartet und werden die skalieren. Es handelt sich um die Abschussanlage DESNA, die bereits in der Ukraine eingesetzt wird.

items.title: Zelensky says comprehensive solution to counter Russian glide bombs will be found
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that a comprehensive solution to counter guided aerial bombs will be found.

items.title: Anschlag in Magdeburg: Gut sechs Millionen Euro Hilfen an Betroffene ausgezahlt
items.teaser: An Betroffene des Anschlags in Magdeburg sind bisher gut sechs Millionen Euro an Hilfen ausgezahlt worden. Am zweiten Jahrestag des Anschlags soll der Weihnachtsmarkt öffnen – allerdings verkürzt.

items.title: Russia now goes after Ukraine’s water, not only its power. City without sewage faces epidemic within three days, a Kyiv water utility official warns
items.teaser: Ukraine is preparing its large cities for water and sewage outages after Russian strikes.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: 'Evacuation, air raid,' — Russian military aircraft approach South Korean island, trigger alert
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 24: 'Evacuation, air raid,' — Russian military aircraft approach South Korean island, trigger air raid alert Zelensky confirms Ukrainian attack on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland Russia breaks yearly troop losses record in Ukraine at 432,519 casualties, General Staff says Ukraine, Norway

items.title: EU’s new sanctions proposal takes aim at Russian war funding and sports participation as sporting world moves to readmit Russian athletes
items.teaser: The European Commission wants to tighten restrictions on Russian banks, energy projects, and military suppliers, while proposing an entry ban for former combatants and further limits on Russian participation in European sports.

items.title: Zelenskyy summarises meeting with Hungarian PM: energy, trade and support discussed
items.teaser: Péter Magyar and Volodymyr Zelenskyy discussed gas and diesel supplies, trade, humanitarian demining and new rail routes during their meeting in Uzhhorod.

items.title: Around 100 civilians trapped on Russian-occupied Kinburn Spit face severe food, medicine shortages, Ukrainian military says
items.teaser: Most of those remaining in the villages of Pokrovske, Vasylivka, and Heroiske are elderly residents who have been unable to evacuate due to extensive Russian minefields and restrictions imposed by occupying forces.

items.title: Zelensky outlines what could force Russia to agree to a ceasefire
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the resilience and unity of Ukraine’s partners – the United States and Europe – combined with Russia’s heavy battlefield losses and mounting economic costs, would eventually force Moscow to agree to a ceasefire.

items.title: Russian drone strikes civilian car in Sumy: 76-year-old man killed
items.teaser: A Russian fibre-optic FPV drone hit a civilian car in Sumy's Kovpakivskyi district, killing a 76-year-old passenger; his son, the driver, is in hospital.

items.title: Ukraine and Hungary discuss gas and diesel supplies, new rail links
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar have agreed to work on arrangements for supplying gas and diesel fuel to Ukraine, expanding Hungarian companies’ use of Ukrainian gas storage facilities, and launching direct train services on new routes.

items.title: Hundreds of Ukrainian defense tech companies already use AI – Zelensky
items.teaser: Hundreds of Ukrainian defense tech companies are already incorporating artificial intelligence (AI) into their operations, President Volodymyr Zelensky has said.

items.title: Über 432,5 Tausend Soldaten seit Jahresbeginn: russische Verluste erreichen neuen Rekord
items.teaser: Die russische Armee verliert im Ukraine- Krieg täglich Tausende Soldaten. In den fast 11 Monaten dieses Jahres hat Russland Rekordverluste seit Kriegsbeginn erlitten: 432.519 Soldaten wurden getötet oder verwundet. Dies entspricht der Bevölkerungszahl in vier Regionen Russlands.

items.title: Ukraine can cover only a third of its 2027 funding needs with domestic resources – Koretskyi
items.teaser: Ukraine can cover only about one-third of its funding needs for 2027 from domestic resources and expects to secure the remainder from international partners. Meanwhile, local communities must step up winter preparations and strengthen security measures, regardless of their location in the country.

items.title: Ukrainian foreign minister advises Putin to stop complaining about strikes on oil refineries and end war instead
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has responded to Russian ruler Vladimir Putin's complaints about Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries, advising him to order an end to the war instead.

items.title: Number of Russian attacks on Naftogaz facilities since start of war exceeds 800
items.teaser: Naftogaz says its facilities have been struck more than 800 times since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion, but its plants continue producing oil and gas.

items.title: Belarusian leader says he could fly to Putin with Zelenskyy on same plane
items.teaser: The Belarusian leader says he could act as Zelenskyy's security guarantor during a trip to Moscow, claiming the three leaders could agree on ending the war.

items.title: Russen greifen Wohnhochhaus in Dnipro an: sechs Menschen verletzt
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben im Laufe des Tages fast 30 - mal die Region Dnipropetrowsk mit Drohnen und Artillerie angegriffen. In der Regionhauptstadt Dnipro wurden sechs Personen verletzt.

items.title: Poll: 53% of Germans oppose continued military aid to Ukraine
items.teaser: In Germany, 53% of respondents oppose continued military support for Ukraine, up from 39% last year, while support for this assistance has declined from 59% to 46%.In Germany, 53% of respondents oppose continued military support for Ukraine, up from 39% last year, while support for this assistance has declined from 59%

items.title: Ukraine's National Guard destroys 22 pieces of Russian military equipment in one operation – video
items.teaser: Ukraine's National Guard unit struck 22 pieces of Russian equipment in one operation, particularly tanks, command vehicles, engineering equipment and lorries.

items.title: Bridges become new battlefield between Russia and Ukraine as front line gains freeze
items.teaser: As the city wakes up, dozens of people stream across Kyiv's Southern Bridge, walking over the Dnipro River on their way to work. Until recently, the same journey took just minutes by metro. Now, with that option gone, their daily commute can stretch into hours. While Russian attacks

items.title: UK warns companies supplying Ukraine of Russian sabotage threat
items.teaser: British officials said Russia had stepped up sabotage attempts against European defense facilities in recent months, often using recruited operatives to carry out arson attacks and other operations aimed at weakening support for Ukraine. The threat also includes espionage, intimidation, and information operations, acco

items.title: Injury toll in Russian strike on Dnipro apartment building rises to six
items.teaser: Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day, injuring six people in the city of Dnipro.

items.title: Hungarian PM says he hosted refugees from Zakarpattia Oblast
items.teaser: Prime Minister Péter Magyar says Hungary has provided refuge to tens of thousands of Ukrainians since Russia's full-scale invasion, including many ethnic Hungarians.

items.title: "Categorical objection": Ukrainian government responds to appointment of Russian official to senior IAEA post
items.teaser: Kyiv says Aleksei Ferapontov was involved in Russia's seizure of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant and demands that the IAEA reverse his appointment.

items.title: Britischer Verteidigungsminister besucht Frontstadt Charkiw und kündigt Lieferung zusätzlicher RapidRanger-Starter an
items.teaser: Der britische Verteidigungsminister Wes Streeting hat die ostukrainische Frontstadt Charkiw besucht, wie The Guardian berichtet.

items.title: Putin complains that Ukraine is striking Russian oil refineries despite Trump's request and vows retaliation
items.teaser: Russian ruler Vladimir Putin claims Ukraine ignored Trump's direct request to stop attacking oil facilities and says Moscow's response is inevitable.

items.title: Ukraine says it hit over 4,000 Russian ground robots in 2026 and that the losses force Russia to put troops and armor into supply runs
items.teaser: The Ukrainian General Staff's separate tally since 2022 is lower: 3,213 ground robots as of 23 November.

items.title: Hungarian PM announces aid for Zakarpattia Oblast during visit to Uzhhorod
items.teaser: During his visit to Uzhhorod, Prime Minister Péter Magyar also announced a new social support fund for Hungarians living abroad.

items.title: Ukraine to scale up DESNA air defense launcher production jointly with Norway
items.teaser: Ukraine and Norway have jointly developed the DESNA air defense launcher and are now working to scale up its production and deployment. The system is already in service with Ukraine’s forces.

items.title: Estonia sending signal to Ukraine not to pollute Baltic Sea – Estonian PM
items.teaser: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Tallinn will signal to Ukraine about Baltic Sea pollution risks from strikes on Russian shadow fleet tankers.

items.title: Kyiv Appeals Court upholds detention of woman accused of posing as paramedic during clashes at National Guard facility
items.teaser: The Kyiv Court of Appeal has upheld the pretrial detention without bail of a woman suspected of obstructing the operations of a National Guard of Ukraine unit in Kyiv region.

items.title: Kinder in Region Donezk zwangsevakuiert
items.teaser: Die unter nadauernedem russischem Beschuss leidende ostukrainische Region Donezk hat die Zwangsevakuierung von Familien mit Kindern aus 2 weiteren grenznahen Gemeinden angeordnet.

items.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy and Hungary's Magyar meet amid thaw in ties
items.teaser: Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar has arrived in Ukraine for meetings with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and ethnic Hungarians. Both leaders say they want better relations after a change of leadership in Budapest.

items.title: Ukraine, Norway to expand joint DESNA air defense system as Oslo plans $7 billion in 2027 aid
items.teaser: The ministers also discussed supplying additional combat aircraft and ammunition, expanding cooperation on unmanned systems, and scaling up cooperation through joint production projects and the exchange of battlefield experience.

items.title: Russia has targeted Naftogaz facilities more than 800 times since the full-scale invasion
items.teaser: Russian forces have carried out more than 800 attacks on Naftogaz Group facilities since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine's bid for NATO membership and more air defense remains controversial
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is calling for the rapid acceptance of his country into NATO. However, the necessary unanimity for this is lacking, as shown during the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin.

items.title: Ukraine's defence minister announces major air defence agreements with Norway
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara met Norway's Tore O. Sandvik in Oslo, announcing major air defence deals and at least US$7 billion in 2027 aid.

items.title: Two women injured as Russian drone hits homes and shop in Chernihiv Region
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike has damaged several private homes and a shop in the town of Snovsk, in the Koriukivka district of Chernihiv Region, leaving two women injured.

items.title: Russia is turning everyday life in Ukraine into an act of survival
items.teaser: Editor's note: The following piece is a personal essay. The author is a Ukrainian police officer. It was a chilly October morning. I was driving my 14-year-old daughter to school. Classes start at 8 a.m., and, as she often does, she began asking me questions about geopolitics.

items.title: Intelligence warns of potential Russian attacks on British companies supporting Ukraine – media
items.teaser: British companies and organisations providing assistance to Ukraine’s Defense Forces, including by supplying weapons components and equipment or providing logistical support, have been warned by the government that they could become targets of Russian sabotage.

items.title: Sweden announces winter support package for Ukraine
items.teaser: Sweden announced a winter aid package for Ukraine on 24 November, including funding for the Ukrainian Red Cross, the energy sector and civil defence.

items.title: Italy’s Foreign Minister voices concern over Ukraine’s strike on Russian vessels in Libya
items.teaser: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani has voiced concern to his Ukrainian counterpart, Andrii Sybiha, over Ukraine’s attack on Russian vessels in the Libyan port of Benghazi.

items.title: Moldova proposes reviving Prut River navigation with Romania, strengthening links with Ukraine
items.teaser: Moldova has proposed restoring navigation on the Prut River to Romania, starting with a Giurgiulești-Galați pilot section to boost transport links with Ukraine.

items.title: Russians strike business in Rivne Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a civilian business in the Sarny district in Rivne Oblast on 24 November, sparking a fire, with no casualties reported so far.

items.title: Magyar reports significant progress in talks with Ukraine on rights of Hungarian minority
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said significant progress had been made in talks with the Ukrainian side on ten issues concerning the language, cultural and educational rights of the Hungarian national minority in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia breaks yearly troop losses record in Ukraine at 432,519 casualties, General Staff says
items.teaser: The General Staff said the latest figure is higher than the combined population of four Russian regions.

items.title: Getreidelager in Region Odessa bei russischem Angriff beschädigt
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben 24. November ein landwirtschaftliches Unternehmen und Getreidelagerhallen in der Region Odessa angegriffen.

items.title: Zelensky makes first statement after meeting with Magyar in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky made his first statement to the press after paying tribute to fallen Ukrainian soldiers in Uzhhorod alongside Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar.

items.title: Germany set to be first NATO country to use DELTA, Ukraine’s battle command system. Berlin will adapt it for its forces and help build new features
items.teaser: However, Berlin will not get access to Ukraine's combat data.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine needs €115bn for 2027, with €90bn currently agreed
items.teaser: European partners have agreed to provide €90bn, leaving a €25bn funding gap. Zelenskyy says the government is working to secure the remaining amount.

items.title: Zelenskyy and Hungarian PM Magyar honour fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar met in Uzhhorod on 24 November to honour Ukraine's fallen defenders.

items.title: Selenskyj und Magyar ehren in Uschhorod gefallene Soldaten
items.teaser: In der westukrainischen Stadt Uschhorod haben der Präsident der Ukraine, Wolodymyr Selenskyj und der ungarische Ministerpräsident Péter Magyar die gefallenen Verteidiger der Ukraine geehrt, wie der Ukrinform - Korrespondent berichtet.

items.title: UK defence secretary visits Kharkiv, announces additional RapidRanger launchers for Ukraine
items.teaser: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited the Ukrainian city of Kharkiv, located just 20 kilometers from the front line.

items.title: What can Ukraine expect in 2027? KI Insights monthly briefing
items.teaser: Ukraine enters 2027 with a wartime budget, a large financing gap, and a diplomatic track that could change everything or nothing. items.title: Australia mulls closing key Russian oil loophole, but with no deadline in mind
items.teaser: "The Government is carefully considering the recommendations of the Senate report to ensure Australia's sanctions on Russia remain fit for purpose, and will table a response in due course," Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong wrote to civil society coalition B4Ukraine.

items.title: Zelensky and Magyar pay tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod.

items.teaser: The piercing air raid siren drowned out the rumbling, hammering, and welding at a war-battered thermal power plant operated by DTEK, Ukraine’s largest private energy company. items.title: Hungarian Prime Minister arrives in Zakarpattia
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Ukraine's Zakarpattia (Transcarpathia) region on November 24 to meet with representatives of the local Hungarian community and separately with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Zelensky confirms Ukrainian attack on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: While he defended Ukraine's right to strike the ship, he also acknowledged that the strike may have raised concerns among Ukraine's allies.

items.title: Kh-101s, a helicopter, and drones: five days of airspace incidents on NATO’s and Moldova’s edges
items.teaser: Poland's military authorized a shootdown of a Russian drone overnight, then held fire as it turned east.

items.title: Russians strike Dnipro: high-rise building damaged, four injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Dnipro on 24 November, damaging a high-rise residential building and injuring at least four people, Governor Oleksandr Hanzha said.

items.title: Around 100 people on Kinburn Spit left without food or medicine, locals call for rescue mission
items.teaser: Around 100 people, most of whom are elderly, remain in three villages under Russian occupation on the Kinburn Spit. Ukraine's defence forces are considering a humanitarian mission to deliver aid.

items.title: The burning Sparta II drifted into Finnish waters off Loviisa before Russia towed it away, and Kyiv now says it struck it
items.teaser: Finland's Border Guard led the response until a Russian rescue ship towed the burning vessel out of Finland's economic zone.

items.title: Selenskyj bestätigt Angriff auf russischen Frachter im Finnischen Meerbusen
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj hat einen Angriff auf das russische Frachtschiff „Sparta II“ im Finnischen Meerbusen am Samstag, den 21. November bestätigt.

items.title: Latvian President sees potential turning point in Ukraine war next year
items.teaser: Russia's war against Ukraine could reach a turning point next year, potentially leading to Moscow's defeat as the Russian economy deteriorates and international pressure mounts.

items.title: Russians strike farm and grain warehouses in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked a farm and wheat warehouses in Odesa Oblast. No casualties have been reported.

items.title: UK defence secretary announces additional RapidRanger air defence systems for Ukraine during Kharkiv visit
items.teaser: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited Kharkiv and announced additional RapidRanger air defence launchers for Ukraine following a request from Zelenskyy.

items.title: On a Matter or Involving It? What the BBNJ COP Can Ask ITLOS about Other Bodies
items.teaser: The first meeting of the Conference of the Parties (COP) to the BBNJ Agreement opens in New York on 11 January 2027. items.title: Blocked Kerch Strait further traps Russia's Black Sea Fleet – Ukrainian Navy Spokesperson
items.teaser: The ability of the Russian Black Sea Fleet to maneuver and leave the Black Sea has been further restricted by the closure of the Kerch Strait.

items.title: Ukrainian parliament passes bill to strengthen asset disclosure rules for security officials
items.teaser: Most top SBU officials would also have to file asset declarations, and they would have to be public, according to the bill.

items.title: Sybiha, Tajani discuss security in Black and Mediterranean Seas following strikes on Russian vessels off Libya
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and his Italian counterpart Antonio Tajani discussed security challenges in the Black and the Mediterranean Seas, freedom of navigation, and diplomatic efforts to end Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Selenskyj will sich an neu gewählten US-Kongress wenden, falls Trump keine Einigung mit Putin über Ende des Krieges erzielen kann
items.teaser: Der Präsident der Ukraine, Wolodymyr Selenskyj, plant, sich an den neu gewählten US- Kongress zu wenden, damit dieser den Druck auf Russland verstärkt, falls es Präsident Donald Trump nicht gelingt, den Kremlchef zu überzeugen, den Krieg bis zum Ende des Jahres zu beenden.

items.title: Zelensky confirms strike on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed that Ukraine struck the Russian cargo ship Sparta II with a drone in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday, November 21.

items.title: Moldova to bring its Russia, Belarus sanctions in line with EU as part of membership requirements
items.teaser: The EU has sanctioned over 4,700 individuals and entities as a result of Russia's war on Ukraine, and for a country to join the bloc, they need to implement every restriction as their own.

items.title: Ukraine to issue formal protest to IAEA over appointment of sanctioned Russian official as Grossi's deputy
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has instructed diplomats to issue a formal demarche to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and deliver a note of protest over the appointment of Alexei Ferapontov, deputy head of Russia's Federal Environmental, Industrial and Nuclear Supervision Service (Rostekhnadzor)

items.title: Is North Korea holding back on sending Russia more troops?
items.teaser: A North Korean troop buildup Ukraine warned about months ago has yet to materialize, even as strategic cooperation continues. Analysts say Pyongyang is balancing its ties with Moscow and Beijing.

items.title: Litauen hat der Ukraine seit 2022 Militärhilfe in Höhe von über einer Milliarde USD geleistet – Generalstab
items.teaser: Seit Anfang 2022 hat Litauen der Ukraine Militärhilfe in Höhe von über einer Milliarde US-Dollar zukommen lassen.

items.title: Ukraine condemns decision to hand world nuclear body lead role to sanctioned Russian
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha branded Ferapontov's appointment as IAEA deputy director general "absurd," and described him as "an accomplice in one of the greatest threats and gravest crimes against nuclear safety."

items.title: Zelensky to reach out to new US Congress if Trump fails to reach deal with Putin to end war
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky plans to reach out to the new Democrat-controlled U.S. Congress to intensify pressure on Russia if President Donald Trump fails to convince Vladimir Putin to end the war by the end of the year.

items.title: From Rostov to Perm, Ukraine’s drones attacked 15 Russian refineries in November
items.teaser: The latest strikes reached Perm and Rostov Oblast, after Russia's refining fell to about half of capacity in mid-November.

items.title: Norway in talks with Ukraine over attacks on Russian ships and regional stability
items.teaser: Norwegian Defense Minister Tore Sandvik said on Tuesday, November 24, that Oslo was holding talks with Ukraine on the “need for stability in our near areas.”

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte treffen angehäufte Lkw der Russen in Region Brjansk
items.teaser: Am 23. und in der Nacht zum 24. November griffen die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte einen Ort an, an dem die Lkw der russischen Truppen nahe Berestok in der Region Brjansk konzentriert waren.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Korosten railway station kills one, injury toll rises to three
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a railway station in Korosten, Zhytomyr region, with a drone, killing one person and injuring three others.

items.title: Selenskyj: Letzte Nacht konzentrierten sich russische Angriffe auf Region Schytomyr, Schutz hat funktioniert
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte auf Facebook, dass die Russen letzte Nacht ihre Angriffe auf die Region Schytomyr, auf die Infrastruktur für die Stromverteilung und -übertragung, konzentriert hätten. Der Schutz habe funktioniert, so Selenskyj.

items.title: Hospital damaged in Russian attack on Odesa
items.teaser: A municipal hospital building in Odesa was damaged in a Russian attack on the afternoon of November 24.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit Russian military truck concentration area in Bryansk region
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck an area where Russian military trucks were concentrated near Berestok in Russia's Bryansk region on November 23 and overnight into November 24.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine needs more F-16s and will need more Gripens to counter Russia’s jet-powered Shaheds
items.teaser: Kyiv expects the Swedish jets from January and has asked allies for 40 more fighters.

items.title: Bombed factories, billion-dollar opportunity: Why German companies keep investing in Ukraine

items.teaser: Körber-Stiftung's 2026/27 The Berlin Pulse survey shows 82% of Germans consider Russia under Vladimir Putin a military threat, while 51% back decisive responses to hybrid attacks and 83% favour US-China neutrality.

items.teaser: Die Firma Megaspeed erlangte innerhalb kurzer Zeit weltweite Aufmerksamkeit. Grund war die Affäre von Nvidia-Chef Huang mit einer früheren Managerin des Unternehmens, die der Spionage verdächtigt wird. Nun landete Megaspeed auf einer US-Sperrliste.

items.title: Ukraine government welcomes newly proposed EU sanctions package

items.title: Air defenses neutralize 73 of 96 drones Russia launched against Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine’s air defenses neutralized 73 of the 96 drones Russian forces launched against the country from the evening of November 23 into the morning of November 24.

items.title: Angriff auf Saporischschja tötet zwei und verletzt 40 Menschen
items.teaser: In der Stadt Saporischschja ist die Zahl der Verletzten nach dem russischen Angriff auf 40 gestiegen, zwei Menschen wurden getötet.

items.title: Russian strike on Dymer claims 12 lives as woman rescued from under rubble dies in hospital

items.title: Russia’s war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,848 over past day
items.teaser: Russia has lost an estimated 1,641,489 troops in its full-scale war against Ukraine since February 24, 2022, including 1,848 over the past 24 hours.

items.title: 1848 Soldaten - Kampfverluste der Russen am Vortag
items.teaser: Die Gesamtkampfverluste der russischen Besatzungstruppen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 24. November 2026 werden auf etwa 1.641489 (+1848 zum Vortag) getötete und verwundete Invasoren geschätzt.

items.title: Tusk urges V4 partners to support Ukraine amid Russian aggression
items.teaser: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called on Visegrad Group countries to jointly support Ukraine and show solidarity with Poland amid Russian aggression, which poses a threat to European countries.

items.title: Weapons, war and wavering trust: Germans want to see more restraint in foreign policy
items.teaser: According to a study by the Körber Foundation, a growing number of Germans now oppose providing military aid to Ukraine. The majority also believes that Germany should take a neutral position between the US and China.

items.title: Ukraine and Germany reach preliminary agreement on additional interceptor missiles for Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara and his German counterpart Boris Pistorius discussed strengthening Ukraine's air defences, defence industry cooperation and drone procurement for 2027 during a meeting in Berlin.

items.title: Ukrainian drone units hit over 4,000 Russian ground robotic systems this year
items.teaser: Unmanned systems units of Ukraine's Defense Forces have destroyed or disabled 4,073 Russian ground robotic systems since the beginning of this year.

items.title: Russians attack three districts of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast with drones, injuring two men in Pavlohrad
items.teaser: Russian drones targeted the Pavlohrad, Samar and Nikopol districts, causing a fire in Pavlohrad and damaging storage facilities in the Samar district. Two men aged 29 and 36 are receiving outpatient treatment.

items.title: Gen-Z-Proteste: Verfassungsschutz warnt vor Beeinflussung durch Linksextreme
items.teaser: Beim "Schulstreik gegen Wehrpflicht" sollen laut Verfassungsschutz linksextremistische Gruppen maßgeblich beteiligt sein.

items.teaser: Immer mehr Deutsche finden, das Land solle sich außenpolitisch zurückhalten. Eine Mehrheit ist gegen Waffen-Hilfen für die Ukraine. Und dafür, dass das Land eine neutrale Position im Streit der USA mit China einnimmt.

items.title: Lithuania provides Ukraine with over USD 1B in military aid since 2022 – General Staff
items.teaser: Lithuania has provided Ukraine with more than $1 billion in military assistance since the beginning of 2022.

items.title: Russian forces attack Vinnytsia twice: fire breaks out, one person injured
items.teaser: Emergency crews are working at the scene of a fire in Vinnytsia following a Russian drone attack on 24 November. Ukraine's Air Force had earlier warned of a jet-powered drone approaching the city.

items.title: Greece developing route for Ukrainian grain exports via Alexandroupolis port – media
items.teaser: Greece is working on a pilot route to export Ukrainian grain to global markets via the port of Alexandroupolis, with an initial test shipment potentially being delivered to the port by rail.

items.title: Russian drone enters Polish airspace during attack on Ukraine
items.teaser: A Russian drone violated Polish airspace during an attack on western Ukraine. Poland's military said they decided to refrain from using weapons due to the risk of causing damage to civilians.

items.teaser: Two people were killed and 11 injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, which damaged apartment buildings, private houses and a transport infrastructure facility.

items.title: 2 killed, 44 injured in Russian attack on residential building in Zaporizhzhia
items.teaser: Mykhailo Semikin, the head of the Zaporizhzhia Oblast Military Administration, reported that Russian forces partially destroyed a five-story residential building in the Kosmichnyi district of the city.

items.title: Russia develops new reconnaissance version of Molniya drone with gasoline engine – presidential advisor
items.teaser: Russian forces have developed a new reconnaissance version of the Molniya unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a gasoline engine.

items.title: Hungarian PM says he will visit Zakarpattia region soon
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Monday that he would visit Ukraine's Zakarpattia region soon to express his support for the ethnic Hungarian minority living there.

items.title: Russian aircraft enter South Korea's air defence identification zone – Yonhap
items.teaser: Russian military aircraft briefly entered South Korea's air defence identification zone near Ulleungdo on 24 November, prompting an evacuation warning after they were mistakenly identified as potentially North Korean aircraft.

items.title: Explosion, fire reported after drone crashes in Transnistria
items.teaser: Moldova's IPN news agency reported that the drone crashed around 6:45 p.m. local time near the town of Dnestrovsc, which is located adjacent to the Ukrainian border in Odesa Oblast. Eyewitnesses told IPN that the drone exploded on impact with a fire reported near a gas station.

items.title: Deutschland baut künftig ukrainische Drohnen
items.teaser: Bereits im April hatten Deutschland und die Ukraine vereinbart, militärisch enger zusammenzuarbeiten - etwa beim Drohnenbau. Verteidigungsminister Pistorius wurde nun konkreter. Mit Blick auf mögliche russische Angriffspläne im All mahnte er zur Ruhe.

items.title: Ukraine's foreign minister warns Russian strikes on ports threaten global food security
items.teaser: Andrii Sybiha has warned that Russian attacks on Ukrainian export infrastructure threaten the livelihoods of millions worldwide, stressing that the consequences of Russia's war extend far beyond Europe.

items.title: Olga Kharlan calls on Melania Trump to help secure release of civilians from Kinburn Spit
items.teaser: Olympic fencing champion Olga Kharlan, who hails from Mykolaiv, has appealed to U.S. First Lady Melania Trump to help secure the release of civilians from the temporarily occupied Kinburn Spit.

items.title: Russian unmanned aerial vehicle violates Polish airspace days after missile incursion
items.teaser: Around 11 p.m. local time, Poland's Government Security Center issued an air-attack alert in parts of the Lublin region in the country's east. About an hour later, the alert was ended.

items.title: NATO secretary general comments on reports of Russia's possible deployment of nuclear weapons in space
items.teaser: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte has reaffirmed the Alliance's commitment to protecting its members against threats in space, while German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has expressed concern over Russia's potential deployment of nuclear weapons in orbit.

items.title: Estonia must get used to Ukrainian drone attacks in the Baltic Sea, Prime Minister says
items.teaser: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Ukraine’s attacks on Russian vessels in the Baltic Sea were understandable, adding that such attacks were something countries should get used to and be prepared for.

items.title: Brazil requests dispute panel regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
items.teaser: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 November, members considered a request from Brazil for the establishment of a dispute panel to review additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974.

items.title: EU sanctions against terrorism: Council lists the founder of 'The Base'
items.teaser: The Council expands its sanctions list to combat terrorism by designating the founder and leader of the EU-sanctioned organisation 'The Base'.

items.title: Zelensky calls for NATO to admit Ukraine at alliance assembly
items.teaser: "Wouldn't it be more effective to simply admit Ukraine into NATO?" Zelensky said. "Wouldn't that be better for all of us, for everyone? Wouldn't it be more feasible? And wouldn't it be more reliable when it comes to actually guaranteeing security?"

items.title: Ukraine's Defense Forces destroy 1,004 Russian tanks since start of 2026
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces have destroyed 1,004 Russian tanks since the beginning of 2026, equivalent to approximately six Eiffel Towers in terms of total metal weight.

items.title: Aktuelles zum Krieg in der Ukraine
items.teaser: Seit Februar 2022 führt Russland einen Angriffskrieg gegen die Ukraine, die Kämpfe dauern an. Alle Entwicklungen und Ukraine-News im Liveticker.

items.title: Russian drone enters Poland during attack on Ukraine but is not shot down
items.teaser: The Polish military authorised the downing of a Russian drone that entered the country's airspace on 24 November but decided against opening fire due to the potential risk to civilians.

items.title: Russia lacks capability to recover Kerch Bridge spans from seabed – Ukrainian Navy spokesperson
items.teaser: Russia lacks the capability to raise the spans of the Kerch Bridge from the seabed, while foreign companies are unlikely to take part in the operation because the area is an active combat zone.

items.title: Christian Mölling, Think Tanks Edina, zum Ukraine-Krieg und einer gefährlichen Eskalation in Europa

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1734: Merz says Ukraine in NATO in 2008 could have stopped war
items.teaser: Meanwhile, Ukrainian drones struck Russian ships from the Gulf of Finland to a Libyan port in November, sinking the corvette Mercury.

items.title: Ukraine in NATO could probably have stopped Russia’s war, German Chancellor Merz says, 18 years after Berlin helped shut the door
items.teaser: Meanwhile, NATO chief Mark Rutte warns that Russia’s war machine won’t stop when the war in Ukraine ends.

items.title: Russia repeatedly altered details on killing of imprisoned Ukrainian journalist Viktoriia Roshchyna
items.teaser: Hacked information provides the latest information about what happened to Roshchyna, a Ukrainska Pravda journalist who died in Russian captivity after torture in the fall of 2024. Roshchyna, 27, disappeared in August 2023 while reporting from Russian-occupied territories.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine to continue naval strikes after hitting two Russian vessels off Libya
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelensky said Ukraine is responding appropriately to Russian attacks and that its naval operations will continue.

items.title: Ukraine’s raid on Russia’s Baltic Fleet base at Baltiysk was likely reconnaissance, aviation expert says
items.teaser: He expects its next serious blow to fall on Primorsk, Russia’s largest oil-export port there.

items.title: Ukraine plans to open its Diia app to foreigners abroad, letting them get tax number and other state services online

items.title: Zelensky: Intelligence reports Russia preparing new strikes on Ukraine
items.teaser: The Ukrainian authorities currently have intelligence indicating that Russia is preparing new attacks on Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine at UN: Demand for withdrawal of Ukrainian troops from Donbas neither compromise nor road to peace

items.title: Official Russian registries confirm over 700,000 military personnel killed in war against Ukraine
items.teaser: A joint investigation by Mediazona and Meduza into leaked Rosstat databases confirms at least 490,000 registered Russian military deaths through September 2026, estimating 700,000-720,000 killed when accounting for missing troops and registration delays.

items.title: General Staff confirms strike on Lukoil oil refinery in Perm
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck the Lukoil-Permnefteorgsintez oil refinery in Perm, Russia, more than 1,500 km from the Ukrainian border, and the Kaleykino oil pumping station in Tatarstan on November 23.

items.title: Verteidigungsminister: Ukraine hat in den letzten Monaten 16 Abschussrampen für Raketen der Typen Iskander und S-400 zerstört

items.title: German-Ukrainian SPYS interceptor drone shoots down Russian jet-powered Geran-5

items.title: With no huge fleet of its own, Ukraine is now sinking Russia’s warships from Baltic to Mediterranean and off Libya
items.teaser: Ukrainian drones hit Russian ships from the Gulf of Finland to a Libyan port in November, sinking the corvette Mercury, analyst Andrii Klymenko says.

items.teaser: Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj fordert die rasche Aufnahme seines Landes in die NATO. Doch die nötige Einstimmigkeit dafür fehlt, wie sich bei der Parlamentarischen Versammlung der NATO in Berlin zeigte.
